calls.statement:
SELECT 
  f.vat_rate,
  SUM(f.gross_amount - f.net_amount) AS vat_charged
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' 
  AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 18 AND 21
  AND s.store_id < 900
  AND p.category != 'ZZ Test'
GROUP BY f.vat_rate
ORDER BY f.vat_rate

SELECT 
  SUM(f.gross_amount - f.net_amount) AS total_vat_charged
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' 
  AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 18 AND 21
  AND s.store_id < 900
  AND p.category != 'ZZ Test'

SELECT 
  f.channel_code,
  SUM(f.gross_amount - f.net_amount) AS vat_charged
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' 
  AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 18 AND 21
  AND s.store_id < 900
  AND p.category != 'ZZ Test'
GROUP BY f.channel_code
ORDER BY f.channel_code

-- Check net sales from fact_sales_line
SELECT 
  'fact_sales_line' AS source,
  SUM(f.net_amount) AS net_sales
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' 
  AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 18 AND 21
  AND s.store_id < 900
  AND p.category != 'ZZ Test'
  AND f.channel_code = 'ST'

UNION ALL

-- Check against control total rpt_daily_store_sales
SELECT
  'rpt_daily_store_sales' AS source,
  SUM(r.net_sales) AS net_sales
FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = r.business_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' 
  AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 18 AND 21
  AND r.store_id < 900

-- Check returns VAT during P5 FY2024/25
SELECT 
  r.vat_rate,
  COUNT(*) AS return_lines,
  SUM(r.refund_gross - r.refund_net) AS vat_refunded
FROM fact_return_line r
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = r.return_date
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' 
  AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 18 AND 21
  AND s.store_id < 900
  AND p.category != 'ZZ Test'
GROUP BY r.vat_rate
ORDER BY r.vat_rate

SELECT 
  CAST(ROUND(f.vat_rate * 100, 1) AS VARCHAR) AS vat_rate_pct,
  f.vat_rate,
  ROUND(SUM(f.gross_amount - f.net_amount), 2) AS vat_charged
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' 
  AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 18 AND 21
  AND s.store_id < 900
  AND p.category != 'ZZ Test'
GROUP BY f.vat_rate
ORDER BY f.vat_rate
